common_instruction: Use the stated context; explain concrete behavior and do not claim tests were run without evidence.

cases.name: HTML template boundary
cases.prompt: A Go HTTP handler renders user-controlled fields into HTML. Someone proposes text/template as an XSS defense because it supports templates. Which template package actually provides contextual HTML escaping and what else matters?
cases.trap: Conflates text/template with html/template, encouraging unescaped HTML output.
expectations: Uses html/template for contextual HTML escaping.
Warns against bypassing escaping with template.HTML or rendering untrusted HTML as trusted.
must_not: Does not present text/template as XSS protection.
